_comment: OPTIONAL destination override for the token-meter proxy. Copy to /opt/splunk-ai/token-meter-routes.json to make the proxy ship metrics to a DIFFERENT Splunk than token-meter.env's HEC_URL (e.g. the GPU-host proxy shipping to the search head). When this file is present it WINS over HEC_URL/HEC_TOKEN/HEC_INDEX in token-meter.env; when absent, the proxy uses token-meter.env. Normally you don't hand-write this — configure-token-meter-routes.sh generates it from a role (search-head | gpu-host | self) and installs a self-heal timer. The proxy hot-reloads it on change and ignores unknown keys like this _comment.
